entryPointCandidates.name: README.md
entryPointCandidates.summary: Comprehensive project documentation covering SAPMAP's architecture, installation, CLI/GUI usage, exploitation modules (10KBlaze, BAPI, AutoPwn), LPE, SAProuter, SecStore decryption, SCC integration, scripted scenarios, and reporting. Acts as the primary entry point for users and contributors.

entryPointCandidates.name: Program.cs
entryPointCandidates.summary: SAPMAP-modified MiniPlasma C# implementation of the cldflt race LPE, refactored to run a wrapper batch as SYSTEM via CreateProcessAsUser instead of spawning an interactive console.

entryPointCandidates.name: conftest.py
entryPointCandidates.summary: Pytest configuration that registers every modules subpackage directory on sys.path, mirroring the production package initializer so tests can use flat imports.

entryPointCandidates.name: capture_real_ticket.py
entryPointCandidates.summary: Research utility that logs into a real SAP J2EE NetWeaver instance via HTTPS form authentication, captures the MYSAPSSO2 logon ticket, decodes/parses it, and compares against a forged ticket to validate the project's ticket-forging implementation.

entryPointCandidates.name: compare_with_sap_ticket.py
entryPointCandidates.summary: Diagnostic tool that reads an SAP-issued MYSAPSSO2 ticket via the Gateway SAPXPG channel and compares its structure (including PKCS#7 BER fields) against a locally forged ticket to validate forging fidelity.

config.name: demo_10kblaze.yaml
config.summary: Scripted SAPMAP playbook that compromises SAP S4H end-to-end via the 10KBlaze chain: MS betrusted IP injection, Gateway SAPXPG user creation, RFC harvesting, SecStore download, and business impact assessment.

config.name: demo_10kblaze_and_RFChopping.yaml
config.summary: Extended 10KBlaze playbook that pivots from initial W74 compromise across an RFC trust hop into S4H, then runs landscape-wide chain analysis and impact assessment.

config.name: demo_cve-2025-31324_java_to_abap.yaml
config.summary: End-to-end playbook that exploits CVE-2025-31324 on a Java stack (SJJ), creates a UME admin, then pivots through an RFC destination into ABAP target S4H for impact assessment.

config.name: demo_landscape.yaml
config.summary: Multi-system landscape demo that pre-registers S4H/TWT/ORA nodes, sweeps every gateway and Message Server for vulnerabilities, then exploits S4H and runs trust-chain analysis.

config.name: demo_onprem_to_btp.yaml
config.summary: On-prem to BTP cloud pivot playbook: roots S4H via gateway, decrypts the ABAP SecStore for OAuth client_secrets, harvests BTP-bound credentials, and mints a BTP access token to enumerate destinations.

config.name: demo_saprouter.yaml
config.summary: SAProuter discovery playbook that registers an external router (R15), probes CVE-2017-12636 ROUTER_ADM info leak, then tunnels an internal scan and follow-on GW exploit of W74 through the router.

config.name: demo_scan.yaml
config.summary: Minimal discovery playbook: fast-scan 192.168.2.0/24 for SAP systems, sweep all gateways and Message Servers for vulnerabilities, then analyze trust chains across the landscape.

config.name: demo_simple.json
config.summary: Minimal three-step JSON playbook demonstrating the simplest SAPMAP scripted scenario: add S4H, check gateway vulnerability, and create a user via the gateway exploit.

config.name: java_full_chain.yaml
config.summary: Full Java attack chain playbook: discovers Java/double-stack systems, runs the read-only java_pipeline macro (SecStore decrypt, UME hash dump, JCo destinations, impact assess), then optionally exploits CVE-2025-31324 and creates a UME admin under --confirm.

config.name: java_full_chain_to_ABAP.yaml
config.summary: Java-to-ABAP cross-stack pivot playbook: roots Java SJJ via CVE-2025-31324, hops RFC into Windows ABAP W74, then double-hops into S4H for landscape-wide impact assessment and chain analysis.

config.name: scc_full_chain.yaml
config.summary: SAP Cloud Connector compromise playbook: roots co-located S4H, downloads SCC password hashes, harvests on-host SSFS and backend mappings, probes connectivity, then extracts the full SCC backup keystore.

config.name: scc_config_clean_scoped.ini
config.summary: Test fixture representing a clean, well-scoped SCC Principal Propagation configuration with templated CN (${user_uuid}), email-domain condition, 60-minute certificate validity, and LOCAL propagation mode. Used to assert that the SCC analyzer reports no critical findings on safely scoped configs.

config.name: scc_config_critical_empty.ini
config.summary: Test fixture representing a CRITICAL-severity SCC Principal Propagation misconfiguration: empty subjectPatterns element allows any subject to be issued a short-lived certificate. Used to validate that the analyzer flags missing identity scoping.

config.name: scc_config_critical_name.ini
config.summary: Test fixture with a CRITICAL-severity SCC Principal Propagation finding: CN bound to the unscoped ${name} placeholder with no condition, allowing impersonation across users. Drives the analyzer's identity-attribute heuristics.

config.name: scc_config_high_email.ini
config.summary: Test fixture with a HIGH-severity SCC Principal Propagation finding: CN bound to ${email} without a scoping condition; email collisions or aliases enable lateral identity. Used to validate medium-strength identity binding detection.

config.name: scc_config_high_hardcoded_ddic.ini
config.summary: Test fixture with a HIGH-severity SCC Principal Propagation finding: CN hardcoded to the SAP standard user DDIC, granting any propagated session DDIC's privileges on the backend. Validates detection of hardcoded high-privilege identity binding.

config.name: scc_config_medium_long_validity.ini
config.summary: Test fixture with a MEDIUM-severity SCC Principal Propagation finding: scoped CN (${user_uuid}/OU=HR) is safe but certificateValidityPeriodInMins=1440 and ssoToleranceInHours=24 exceed recommended values. Validates time-window heuristics.

config.name: trustcfg_single_xsuaa.xml
config.summary: Test fixture representing an SCC trustConfiguration with a single XSUAA IdP entry (subaccount + default-jwt-key). Public key is a placeholder. Used to validate trust-store parsing and single-IdP rendering paths.

config.name: trustcfg_xsuaa_plus_ias.xml
config.summary: Test fixture representing an SCC trustConfiguration with two enabled IdPs — XSUAA and IAS — for the same subaccount. Used to validate the analyzer's multi-IdP enumeration and reporting of mixed trust chains.

config.name: manifest.yml
config.summary: Cloud Foundry application manifest declaring the `sapmap-probe-bridge` app: 64 MB single instance using the staticfile buildpack with a random shared-domain route, deployed solely to serve as a `cf ssh -L` tunnel endpoint into BTP's connectivity proxy.

config.name: .understandignore
config.summary: Ignore patterns for the Understand-Anything codebase analyzer, excluding loot, states, screenshots, and SAP runtime artifacts from scanning.

config.name: FodyWeavers.xml
config.summary: Fody weaver configuration enabling Costura to embed NtApiDotNet and TaskScheduler DLLs into mp_bin.exe as a self-contained binary.

config.name: SAPMAP_MiniPlasma.csproj
config.summary: SDK-style .NET project file targeting net472, configuring Costura.Fody dependency embedding and producing the mp_bin.exe LPE artifact.

list.name: Entry & Core State
list.description: CLI/HTTP entry point and the modules/core package: session models, persistence, Bottle REST + HTML GUI, reports, diffs, findings, remediation and shared config.

list.name: Discovery Layer
list.description: Network and SAP system discovery: dispatcher/gateway scanning, authenticated RFC operations, default-credential probing, SCC fingerprinting and principal-propagation analysis.

list.name: Exploitation Layer
list.description: Concrete SAP exploit modules (10KBLAZE Gateway SAPXPG, MS betrusted, CVE-2020-6287/2022-22536/2025-31324, MYSAPSSO2 forge, Windows LPE, dpmon, DB SQL writers) plus orchestrators that chain them.

list.name: Post-Exploitation & Attack Chaining
list.description: Privilege-escalation framework, capability analysis, PSE looting, SSH lateral movement and BFS attack-chain ranking over the discovered RFC trust graph.

list.name: Data Extraction
list.description: Decryption and exfiltration of SAP secrets: ABAP RSECTAB/SecStore, Java SecStoreFS, BTP destination service, OA2C OAuth2 profiles and SCC keystore/SSFS harvesting.

list.name: Protocols Layer
list.description: Low-level SAP protocol primitives: ctypes wrapper for the NW RFC SDK, RSEC cipher, SAProuter NI tunnelling, unauthenticated RFC system-info probes and SNC helpers.

list.name: Automation, Scripts & Ops
list.description: Scripted scenario runner, YAML/JSON playbooks, business-impact scoring, cleanup tooling and the flat-import path injector that glues the modules/* subpackages together.

list.name: Vendored Tools & Helper CLIs
list.description: Vendored native exploit projects (efspotato, godpotato, miniplasma, dirtyfrag, ssfs_decrypt, btp_ssh_bridge) and stand-alone helper CLIs used for ticket capture and SSO2 profile checks.

list.name: Tests
list.description: Pytest suite plus SCC principal-propagation config and trust-config fixtures used to validate parsers and analyzers.

list.name: Documentation
list.description: Project README, legal disclaimer, internal research and implementation-plan notes under docs/research/, and the .understandignore meta file.

file:modules/core/sapmap_models.py.name: sapmap_models.py
file:modules/core/sapmap_models.py.summary: Core dataclasses for the SAP Landscape Attack Path Mapper: severity enum, findings, credentials, created users, forged tickets, trust relations, SAP nodes, RFC connections, SCC and BTP nodes, and the top-level SAPMAPState session container. Every model is JSON-roundtrippable via to_dict/from_dict.

file:modules/core/sapmap_report.py.name: sapmap_report.py
file:modules/core/sapmap_report.py.summary: Engagement report builder: walks an SAPMAPState once and produces both portable Markdown and a self-contained HTML deliverable with executive summary, KPI cards, SVG landscape snapshot, hardening checklist, findings, attack coverage, trust chains, credentials, SCC and BTP sections, and structured remediation.

file:modules/core/sapmap_state.py.name: sapmap_state.py
file:modules/core/sapmap_state.py.summary: Session persistence layer: saves/loads SAPMAPState to/from .sapmap JSON files in states/, maintains an RFC test cache and a created-destination log across sessions, manages the loot directory tree (secstore/hashes/tables/bia), and lists prior saved sessions.

file:modules/core/sapmap_diff.py.name: sapmap_diff.py
file:modules/core/sapmap_diff.py.summary: Computes a structured delta between two SAPMAPState snapshots (added/removed/changed SAP nodes, findings, RFC connections, cloud connectors, trust chains, created users) and renders the diff as Markdown or self-contained HTML matching the engagement-report visual language.

file:modules/core/sapmap_findings.py.name: sapmap_findings.py
file:modules/core/sapmap_findings.py.summary: Module-global findings bus that decouples the discovery and exploit modules from the GUI: any code can call emit_finding(severity, node, msg) and registered listeners receive the dict in real time, with a 60-second dedupe window and 500-entry ring buffer.

file:modules/core/sapmap_gui.py.name: sapmap_gui.py
file:modules/core/sapmap_gui.py.summary: Bottle HTTP backend exposing 60+ REST routes for the SAPMAP single-page app: discovery, RFC operations, exploitation, payload generation, SCC enumeration, console streaming, and session save/load. All long-running tasks run in background threads while the JS frontend polls for state updates.

file:modules/core/sapmap_html.py.name: sapmap_html.py
file:modules/core/sapmap_html.py.summary: Single self-contained 11k-line HTML/CSS/JavaScript bundle for the SAPMAP frontend: interactive SVG landscape map with pan/zoom/drag, RFC connection rendering, right-click context menus, credential dialogs, real-time console, and status bar. Exposed via the single get_html() function.

file:modules/__init__.py.name: __init__.py
file:modules/__init__.py.summary: Package initializer that appends every modules subpackage directory to sys.path so callers can use flat imports (e.g., `from sapmap_models import ...`) regardless of caller location.

file:sapmap.py.name: sapmap.py
file:sapmap.py.summary: Main CLI entry point for SAPMAP — parses arguments, launches the Bottle HTTP server, manages the pywebview GUI window (with GTK/macOS patches), and orchestrates state loading, scripted scenarios, and CLI-only scans.

file:tests/conftest.py.name: conftest.py
file:tests/conftest.py.summary: Pytest configuration that registers every modules subpackage directory on sys.path, mirroring the production package initializer so tests can use flat imports.

file:tools/capture_real_ticket.py.name: capture_real_ticket.py
file:tools/capture_real_ticket.py.summary: Research utility that logs into a real SAP J2EE NetWeaver instance via HTTPS form authentication, captures the MYSAPSSO2 logon ticket, decodes/parses it, and compares against a forged ticket to validate the project's ticket-forging implementation.

file:tools/compare_with_sap_ticket.py.name: compare_with_sap_ticket.py
file:tools/compare_with_sap_ticket.py.summary: Diagnostic tool that reads an SAP-issued MYSAPSSO2 ticket via the Gateway SAPXPG channel and compares its structure (including PKCS#7 BER fields) against a locally forged ticket to validate forging fidelity.

file:modules/exploitation/sap_betrusted_.name: sap_betrusted_chain.py
file:modules/exploitation/sap_betrusted_.summary: Orchestrates the Message Server betrusted + Gateway 10KBLAZE exploit chain: registers a fake internal application server via the MS internal port, then leverages the resulting trust to invoke SAPXPG OS commands without authentication.

file:modules/exploitation/sap_db_sql_wri.name: sap_db_sql_writers.py
file:modules/exploitation/sap_db_sql_wri.summary: Multi-database SQL execution layer for the Gateway 10KBLAZE primitive: emits per-DB (Oracle, MSSQL, HANA, MaxDB, DB2) OS command sequences that pipe SQL into the local DB client through SAPXPG.

file:modules/exploitation/sapmap_exploit.name: sapmap_exploit.py
file:modules/exploitation/sapmap_exploit.summary: Central exploitation orchestrator: probes Gateway vulnerability, runs 10KBLAZE OS execution, forges/uses SAP logon tickets, deploys CVE-2025-31324 webshells, creates SAPMAP users across ABAP and Java stacks, and propagates the foothold across the RFC trust graph.

file:modules/exploitation/sapmap_efspota.name: sapmap_efspotato.py
file:modules/exploitation/sapmap_efspota.summary: Windows LPE module that escalates to NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM by coercing lsass.exe via MS-EFSRPC named-pipe authentication, complementing GodPotato on hardened hosts where DCOM unmarshalling yields only Identification-level tokens.

file:modules/exploitation/sapmap_godpota.name: sapmap_godpotato.py
file:modules/exploitation/sapmap_godpota.summary: Windows LPE module implementing BeichenDream's GodPotato chain — abuses SeImpersonatePrivilege via DCOM/RPCSS unmarshalling to spawn arbitrary commands as NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM on Server 2012-2022 and Win10-11.

file:modules/exploitation/sapmap_minipla.name: sapmap_miniplasma.py
file:modules/exploitation/sapmap_minipla.summary: Windows LPE module exploiting CVE-2020-17103 (cldflt.sys race) on Win10 1709+/Server 2019+ to escalate from SAP service account to SYSTEM; also exports the shared OS-exec picker and helper primitives used by GodPotato and EfsPotato.

config:tools/miniplasma/src/SAPMAP_MiniP.name: SAPMAP_MiniPlasma.csproj
config:tools/miniplasma/src/SAPMAP_MiniP.summary: SDK-style .NET project file targeting net472, configuring Costura.Fody dependency embedding and producing the mp_bin.exe LPE artifact.

file:tools/ssfs_decrypt/SecStoreAccess.j.name: SecStoreAccess.java
file:tools/ssfs_decrypt/SecStoreAccess.j.summary: JNI bridge that calls SAP's libsapscc20jni getRecord() to decrypt SAP Cloud Connector SSFS entries; outputs the cleartext as JSON for the SAPMAP loot pipeline.

file:tools/ssfs_decrypt/SecStoreAccessEx.name: SecStoreAccessException.java
file:tools/ssfs_decrypt/SecStoreAccessEx.summary: Trivial checked exception type thrown by SecStoreAccess.getRecord when JNI decryption fails.

document:tools/efspotato/README.md.name: README.md
document:tools/efspotato/README.md.summary: Documents the vendored EfsPotato Windows LPE that abuses MS-EFSR coercion of lsass.exe plus SeImpersonatePrivilege relay to obtain a SYSTEM token.

file:modules/protocols/sap_rfc_system_in.name: sap_rfc_system_info.py
file:modules/protocols/sap_rfc_system_in.summary: Unauthenticated SAP NetWeaver fingerprinting library that probes RFC, Gateway, and DIAG ports using three techniques (V6 single-packet, V2 error-leak, Chipik-style) to harvest SID, kernel release, host, and system numbers without credentials.

file:modules/protocols/sap_router_info.p.name: sap_router_info.py
file:modules/protocols/sap_router_info.p.summary: Issues the NI_INFO request to a SAProuter to retrieve its current connection table and parses each row into a structured record.

file:modules/protocols/sap_rsec_cipher.p.name: sap_rsec_cipher.py
file:modules/protocols/sap_rsec_cipher.p.summary: Pure-Python implementation of SAP's proprietary RSECCipher (8-round Feistel over 3DES with custom S-boxes) used to decrypt ABAP RSECTAB entries.

file:modules/protocols/sap_saprouter.py.name: sap_saprouter.py
file:modules/protocols/sap_saprouter.py.summary: SAProuter NI_ROUTE tunneling primitives that transparently wrap RFC/scan/exploit sockets, allowing SAPMAP to traverse perimeter routers to internal SAP systems.

file:modules/protocols/sap_snc.py.name: sap_snc.py
file:modules/protocols/sap_snc.py.summary: Detects and probes SAP SNC (Secure Network Communications) endpoints on DIAG and router ports, reporting cipher mode and SNC-required policy from the negotiation response.

file:tests/__init__.py.name: __init__.py
file:tests/__init__.py.summary: Empty package marker for the tests directory.

file:tools/btp_ssh_bridge/Staticfile.name: Staticfile
file:tools/btp_ssh_bridge/Staticfile.summary: Minimal Cloud Foundry staticfile_buildpack config used solely as a vehicle for cf-ssh entry into a tenant subaccount; the served content is irrelevant.

file:tools/check_sso2_profile.py.name: check_sso2_profile.py
file:tools/check_sso2_profile.py.summary: Standalone CLI that reads SAP profile files through the GW SAPXPG channel and reports whether the target accepts MYSAPSSO2 tickets in the shape SAPMAP's forger emits.

file:tools/dirtyfrag/build.sh.name: build.sh
file:tools/dirtyfrag/build.sh.summary: Bash build script that compiles the SAPMAP-modified Dirty Frag Linux LPE binary and injects the hex-encoded bytes into modules/exploitation/_dirtyfrag_blob.py.

file:tools/dirtyfrag/exp.c.name: exp.c
file:tools/dirtyfrag/exp.c.summary: SAPMAP-modified Dirty Frag universal Linux LPE chaining xfrm-ESP and RxRPC page-cache writes to root, patched to launch a non-TTY wrapper script instead of dropping a shell.

document:tools/dirtyfrag/README.md.name: README.md
